finding: Machine-audit bridge is healthy, but the semantic-review handoff is not yet robust: the GitHub connector truncates the large one-line audit/latest.json before the complete unresolved candidate array is exposed. The fixed-slot fail-closed policy worked: no production mutation was attempted and no include/exclude decision was fabricated.
recommendedFix: Have the GitHub audit workflow additionally persist a compact audit/unresolved-latest.json containing only generatedAt, summary, active-journal source health, and the complete unresolved/potential-gap records. Pre-review tasks should consume that compact artifact.
